title: •Anakin’s Lightsaber
caption: •Anakin’s Lightsaber (V)
game_text: Deploy on Leia, non-Jedi Luke, or any Mara. May add 1 to Force drain where present. May target a character or creature. Draw two destiny. Target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value. Instead of firing, may use 1 Force to cancel a just drawn weapon destiny here.
lore: Constructed by Anakin Skywalker. Kept by Obi-Wan Kenobi until given to Luke.
copyright: TM & © 1996 LUCASFILM LTD. TM, ® & © 1996 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Unique. Curly apostrophe in the slip heading and caption (Anakin’s). Green Character Weapon frame, banner CHARACTER WEAPON. No inline icons; slip text matches the stub. Margin credits, one line each: left 'Original concept by Peter Nordstrom', right 'Alderaan Regional 2005'. The wiki's default 'Anakin's Lightsaber' page is the Decipher final (Glossary) errata version; printed face = 'Anakin's Lightsaber (Original)' (same lore/destiny/set), whose image is the 350 px decipher-archive scan (src/vs12/01-Hoth-L-anakinslightsaber-decipher-archive.gif — a slightly skewed scan with a drop-shadow border). art.src = the 745 px Hoth-L-anakinslightsaber.gif, tagged D-E1 (errata face: bottom text differs, top half/art/lore identical) — used for art only. Lore matches both scans. Copyright 1996 legible on the 745 px scan. Modern: V10-L-anakinslightsaber.gif (745 px, VS10 remake); 'V10-L-anakinslightsaber ai.gif' (AI-art alternate) and VB2 (350) exist, not downloaded.
